hooks.name: Verify the repository against its own specification
hooks.description: Every acceptance criterion in .kiro/specs is bound to code and to a test. Re-verify on save so a claim that stops being true surfaces immediately rather than at review.

action.command: npm run build --silent && node dist/shall/cli.js verify

hooks.name: Lint a specification the moment it is written
hooks.description: shall lint needs no API key, so open wording can be caught on every save without spending a model call.

hooks.name: Re-verify when a requirement changes
hooks.description: Editing a criterion voids its previous proof. This asks the agent to re-check rather than letting the baseline drift silently.

action.prompt: A requirements document changed. Run `node dist/shall/cli.js verify --verbose` and report every criterion that is now unverified, orphaned or malformed. Do not refresh the baseline until all are conformant.
